The `WarningIcon` consumers in the patient chart app are three order-basket item tiles. Each one renders the icon inside the order-error message, so a change in its behaviour would show up there. The framework-side definition is in `openmrs-esm-core`.

**Patient chart consumers (best first):**

1. **Medications basket tile**: `OrderBasketItemTile` imports `WarningIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` and renders it at line 91 for `orderBasketItem.orderError`. Used by the drug order basket.
   `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:15-134`
2. **Lab/test orders basket tile**: `LabOrderBasketItemTile` renders `WarningIcon` at line 46 for order errors.
   `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:15-90`
3. **General orders basket tile**: `OrderBasketItemTile` renders `WarningIcon` at line 38 for order errors.
   `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx:15-75`

Each tile's `WarningIcon` usage line is also listed separately below, so the exact render sites are covered.

**Framework side (for context):**

- `WarningIcon` is defined in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx:848-852`. `AllergiesIcon` is an alias of it at line 859, and I found no chart usage of `AllergiesIcon`.
- `DatePickerIcon` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/datepicker/date-picker-icon.component.tsx:11-21` renders `WarningIcon` when the picker is invalid. Chart code that uses the framework date picker would be affected indirectly, though it does not reference `WarningIcon` itself. I did not search for those date picker consumers.
- `esm-login-app` also uses `WarningIcon` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:152`), but it is outside the chart app.
